text.EN: It's down... but there are more.
text.TL: Patay na... pero may iba pa.

text.EN: You got it... God, look around us.
text.TL: Nakuha mo... Diyos ko, tingnan mo ang paligid.

text.EN: Dead... but I hear more shuffling.
text.TL: Patay na... pero may naririnig pa akong kaluskos.

text.EN: That one's down... don't let others flank.
text.TL: Bagsak na ang isang 'yon... huwag hayaang may pumaligid.

text.EN: It's over for that one... but we're not safe.
text.TL: Tapos na ang isa... pero hindi pa tayo ligtas.

text.EN: You killed it... please tell me that's the last one.
text.TL: Napatay mo... pakiusap sabihin mong huli na 'yan.

text.EN: One is down... but more could come.
text.TL: Isang bagsak... pero baka may dumating pa.

text.EN: Good, it's dead... just watch the darkness.
text.TL: Mabuti at patay na... mag-ingat lang sa dilim.

text.EN: Down... but my heart won't stop racing.
text.TL: Bagsak... pero ayaw humupa ng kaba ko.

text.EN: You stopped it... but we have to keep checking.
text.TL: Napigilan mo... pero kailangan nating patuloy na magmasid.

text.EN: Good. Just—keep watching them.
text.TL: Ayos. Basta—bantayan mo sila.

text.EN: Nice hit... just don't let them get close.
text.TL: Magandang tama... huwag mo lang silang palapitin.

text.EN: You killed it... keep your eyes on the shadows.
text.TL: Napatay mo... bantayan mo ang mga anino.

text.EN: It's dead... just watch out for more.
text.TL: Patay na... mag-ingat lang sa iba pa.

text.EN: Okay, that one's gone... please stay watchful.
text.TL: Sige, wala na 'yon... pakiusap magmatyag ka.

text.EN: Good swing... don't turn your back on them.
text.TL: Magandang hataw... huwag mo silang tatalikuran.

text.EN: It's on the floor... keep watching every door.
text.TL: Nasa sahig na... bantayan ang bawat pinto.

text.EN: Down... just keep looking everywhere.
text.TL: Bagsak... tumingin ka lang sa lahat ng sulok.

text.EN: You dropped it... God, please be careful.
text.TL: Ibinagsak mo... Diyos ko, mag-ingat ka.

text.EN: Handled... just don't let your guard down.
text.TL: Naasikaso... huwag mo lang ibaba ang depensa.

text.EN: Okay. One less. I still don't like this.
text.TL: Sige. Isa na lang ang nabawas. Ayoko pa rin nito.

text.EN: One down... this whole place creeps me out.
text.TL: Isang bagsak... kinikilabutan ako sa buong lugar na 'to.

text.EN: It's dead. I hate being surrounded like this.
text.TL: Patay na. Ayaw na ayaw kong napapalibutan tayo.

text.EN: One less threat... my knees are shaking.
text.TL: Bawas ang isang banta... nanginginig ang mga tuhod ko.

text.EN: Good, it stopped moving... I'm terrified.
text.TL: Mabuti at tumigil na sa paggalaw... natatakot ako.

text.EN: Down. I just want this nightmare to end.
text.TL: Bagsak. Gusto ko nang matapos ang bangungot na 'to.

text.EN: One less rotten thing... still scares me to death.
text.TL: Bawas ang isang bulok... takot na takot pa rin ako.

text.EN: It's gone. I really, really don't like this.
text.TL: Wala na. Ayoko talaga, ayoko sa ganito.

text.EN: Dead. Can we leave as soon as it's quiet?
text.TL: Patay na. Pwede ba tayong umalis kapag tumahimik na?

text.EN: You killed it... but my hands are ice cold.
text.TL: Napatay mo... pero parang yelo ang lamig ng mga kamay ko.
